# Assets · Icons

22 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for bell.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Brachio's own 16px stroke icons, copied from `ui/src/components/Icon.tsx`. These SVG files draw in a fixed grey ink `#8A8A96` so they show on both themes; in the app the `Icon` component draws the same paths in `currentColor`. 1.5px stroke, round caps and joins. Use them at 15px in buttons, 13px beside labels and 11px in meta lines.
